subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with regard to microfinance?

options.text: Microfinance in India evolved to fill the gaps created by the formal banking institutions.
Microfinance initiative in India was taken by NABARD.
Microfinancing started in India majorly due the nationalisation of banks.
The Reserve Bank of India had appointed the Malegam Committee to go into the regulation of microfinance institutions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Microfinancing started in India majorly due to the nationalisation of banks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Microfinance in India evolved to fill the gaps created by the formal banking institutions.
 
• Microfinance initiative in India was taken by NABARD.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India had appointed the Malegam Committee to go into the regulation of microfinance institutions.
